description: Every distribution chart a Power BI analyst reaches for, done properly, and the statistics that say whether your groups really differ. Six views over the same fields, switched with tabs: box plot, violin, raincloud, ridgeline, beeswarm and histogram. Free, and never blocked Quartiles that match your DAX: Excel / DAX PERCENTILE.INC by default, plus Tukey's hinges, Excel exclusive / Minitab / SPSS and all nine Hyndman-Fan types. The footnote names the method. Box plots: 1.5 x IQR (adjustable), percentile, mean +/- SD or min-max whiskers; outliers and far outliers; mean marker; points behind the box. Density: violin, half violin, split violin, raincloud and ridgeline with Scott, Silverman or R bandwidths and a smoothness control. Histogram: Freedman-Diaconis, Sturges, Scott, Rice, square root, Doane, a fixed count or width, or your own bin edges; round edges and a bin start; count, percent or density; cumulative line; density and normal curves. Reference lines in every view: mean, median and up to four percentiles, for all data or per group. Real data: Split By, sorting by median, mean, spread or n, a minimum group size, and a Value (as column) + Count input that sends each distinct value once, so large tables fit. A smart caption with the finding, a methods footnote, four themes, keyboard navigation, high contrast, cross-filtering, English and Czech. Readers without a licence…
